summary: Sprint 6 Phase 2 Culinary Intelligence Deeplinks testing complete. All backend tests passed (19/19). All frontend deeplink tests passed. Features: primary_action field in generate-now response, notification link matches primary_action.link, history stores primary_action, deeplinks auto-open dialogs (?dialog=menu-engineering|digest|variance), event_id param shows focused event card, menu_id param highlights menu card with amber ring, URL cleaned after consuming params, closing dialog clears focused state.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/culinary-digest/generate-now returns primary_action with {type, link, label, event_id?, menu_id?}
primary_action.type is one of: variance, staleness, low_stock, mise_en_place, menu_engineering, digest
Priority cascade verified: variance > staleness > low_stock > mise_en_place > menu_engineering > digest
GET /api/notifications returns culinary_digest notification with link = primary_action.link
GET /api/culinary-digest/history stores primary_action in each history entry
GET /api/cost-variance/event/{id} returns event detail for deeplink (404 for non-existent)
Frontend deeplink ?dialog=menu-engineering auto-opens Menu Engineering dialog
Frontend deeplink ?dialog=digest auto-opens Culinary Digest dialog
Frontend deeplink ?dialog=variance auto-opens Cost Variance dialog
Frontend deeplink ?dialog=variance&event_id=XYZ shows focused-event card (cv-focused-event) if event exists
Frontend deeplink ?dialog=staleness&menu_id=XYZ highlights menu card with ring-2 ring-amber-400 class
URL params (dialog, event_id, menu_id) are cleaned after consumption
Closing variance dialog clears deeplinkEventId state - manual open does NOT show focused event card
Clean URL /food-ops/menus does NOT auto-open any dialog
Regression: All Sprint 5 endpoints still work (settings, preview, history, generate-now)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing data

notes: All Sprint 6 features working correctly. The primary_action field enables in-app notifications to deeplink directly to the most urgent dialog with preselected context. For this test account, primary_action.type was 'menu_engineering' (1 star, 0 dogs, 0 variance/stale/low_stock/mep_gap). The focused-event card in CostVarianceDialog only appears when a valid event_id is passed AND the event exists in the database.
